_meta.what: Analysts' consensus revenue estimates for past quarters (as they stood at or just before results) and a few missing reported revenues, found by web search 2026-09-29. Values in full units of the company's reporting currency. The pipeline's own earnings_history figures always win where both exist.
_meta.rules: An estimate is kept only if status=found and its currency is the reporting currency, and - where both the source and our data state the actual - the two agree within 1% (116 of the 140 kept were checked this way; 24 had no actual on one side). Partial (stale preview), not_found, pre-announcement and restated items are left out and listed under 'excluded' with the reason. Estimates carry provider, source URL and date (provider 'unnamed' where the source names none); a backfilled actual carries its source URL.
_meta.caveats: Providers differ: LSEG (most US and Korean rows), FactSet, Zacks, Investing.com (Aixtron, Infineon, Nokia, DBS, OCBC) and a few unnamed; three sampled rows differ by >3% between LSEG and Investing.com (SK hynix 2026-03-31, ASML 2025-03-31, MU 2026-02-28), enough to flip a beat into a miss - the provider is on every row. Samsung publishes preliminary results and TSMC monthly revenue before results day, so their consensus already reflects part of the quarter.
